Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one. 3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Recipe👇🏽 Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks Just Got Crispier🌶️🔥 These mozzarella sticks just got a serious upgrade. Double-breaded, fried until golden and crispy, then tossed in a Nashville hot oil that brings the heat. Mozzarella Sticks 3 rectangles low-moisture mozzarella, sliced into ½–1 inch sticks Flour, for dusting 2 eggs, beaten 1½ cups breadcrumbs Oil, for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp brown sugar Slice the low-moisture mozzarella into ½–1 inch sticks and lightly dust them in flour. Freeze for 1 hour. Dip the frozen mozzarella into the egg, then breadcrumbs, then back into the egg and breadcrumbs again. Heat your oil to 350°F and fry the mozzarella straight from frozen for 2–3 minutes, until golden and crispy. You’ll know they’re ready when they float to the top and look nice and puffy. Don’t overcrowd the pan. While they’re frying, mix the Nashville hot oil ingredients together. As soon as the mozzarella sticks come out, brush or toss them in the hot oil while they’re still steaming. Serve immediately with ranch. I hope it crunches.

Slow Cooker Pineapple BBQ Beef Roast Ingredients 1. Beef Chuck Roast – 3–4 lb (1.4–1.8 kg) 2. Pineapple Rings – 1 can (20 oz/565 g), drained, reserving 1/2 cup juice 3. Barbecue Sauce – 1 1/2 cups 4. Pineapple Juice – 1/2 cup, reserved from the can 5. Beef Broth – 1/2 cup 6. Yellow Onion – 1 large, sliced 7. Garlic – 5 cloves, minced 8. Worcestershire Sauce – 2 tbsp 9. Soy Sauce – 2 tbsp 10. Brown Sugar – 2 tbsp 11. Dijon Mustard – 1 tbsp 12. Smoked Paprika – 1 tsp 13. Ground Black Pepper – 1 tsp 14. Salt – 1 tsp, or to taste 15. Onion Powder – 1 tsp 16. Garlic Powder – 1 tsp 17. Olive Oil – 1 tbsp 18. Apple Cider Vinegar – 1 tbsp 19. Cornstarch – 1 tbsp, optional for thickening 20. Cold Water – 2 tbsp, optional for thickening 21. Fresh Parsley – 2 tbsp, chopped, for garnish Recipe 1. Pat the beef chuck roast dry with paper towels. Trim away any unusually thick pieces of excess fat while leaving enough marbling to keep the meat tender during slow cooking. 2. In a small bowl, combine the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Rub the seasoning mixture over all sides of the roast so the beef is evenly flavored. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the roast for 3–4 minutes per side until a deep brown crust forms. This step develops extra flavor, although you can skip it when short on time. 4. Place the sliced onion and minced garlic in the bottom of a 6–8-quart slow cooker. Set the seared beef roast on top of the onion mixture. 5. In a medium bowl, whisk together the barbecue sauce, reserved pineapple juice, beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, Dijon mustard, and apple cider vinegar until smooth. 6. Pour the prepared sauce over the beef, coating the top and sides generously. Arrange the pineapple rings around and on top of the roast so their sweet juices mingle with the savory barbecue sauce. 7. Cover the slow cooker with its lid and cook on LOW for 8–10 hours or on HIGH for approximately 4–6 hours, until the beef is fork-tender and pulls apart easily. Cooking time depends on the roast's size and the slow cooker. 8. Halfway through cooking, carefully spoon some of the sauce over the roast if convenient. Keep the lid closed as much as possible so the slow cooker maintains its temperature. 9. Once the beef is tender, transfer it carefully to a large platter. Use two forks to pull it into thick chunks or slices, depending on your preferred presentation. Remove any large pieces of fat. 10. Taste the cooking liquid and adjust the seasoning if necessary. For a richer glaze, transfer approximately 2 cups of the liquid to a saucepan and simmer over medium heat for 8–12 minutes until reduced and glossy. 11. For a thicker sauce, whisk the cornstarch and cold water together in a small bowl until smooth. Stir the slurry into the simmering sauce and cook for 1–2 minutes until thickened. Add only as much as needed to achieve your preferred consistency. 12. Return the beef to the slow cooker or place it in the saucepan with the reduced sauce. Gently toss the meat so every piece is coated in the sweet, tangy pineapple barbecue glaze. 13. Arrange the pineapple rings around the beef on a serving platter. Spoon additional sauce over the roast and garnish with freshly chopped parsley for a colorful finish. 14. Serve the hot pineapple BBQ beef with mashed potatoes, steamed rice, roasted vegetables, or toasted rolls. Spoon extra sauce over each portion and enjoy the tender beef with its smoky, sweet, and savory flavors. Follow for more delicious slow cooker recipes and amazing food ideas!

How to Make Sticky Toffee Pudding 🇬🇧🍨  FULL RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  (feeds 6 people) INGREDIENTS: Pudding ⬇️ 225g pitted dates (~250g unpitted) 1 + 3/4 cups AP flour 1/2 cup boiling water  2 teabags earl grey  1/2 cup milk, at room temperature  2/3 cup + 1 tbsp unsalted butter, softened 2/3 cup brown sugar 2 eggs, at room temperature  2 tbsp molasses 2 tsp vanilla extract  1 tsp baking soda 1.5 tsp baking powder 1 tsp fine salt Toffee Sauce ⬇️ 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup heavy cream 1/2 cup unsalted butter 2 tsp molasses  To Finish ⬇️ Flaky salt (to taste) 1 pint vanilla ice cream INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Pre-heat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.  2. Bring your water to a boil. If you’d like to try some date-earl gray tea as well, add an extra cup of boiling water (it was actually quite delicious!) 3. Remove the pits from your dates if you haven’t already. Roughly chop your dates, and add them to a heat-proof container. Pour the boiling water over your dates, and add your tea bags. Let the tea steep for 5 minutes, then remove your tea bags. Remove your tea to drink if you added some extra, leaving only a 1/2 cup of hot water to submerge the dates. Add your 1 tbsp of baking soda, and mix it in with the dates (the mixture should start to foam). Let sit for another 5 minutes. 4. While still warm, blend your date mixture with an immersion blender, and set aside to cool to room temperature. In a large mixing bowl, add 2/3 cup of softened butter. Mix with a hand mixer until the butter is smooth & spread around the bottom of the bowl. Add your brown sugar, and mix once more until the butter & sugar are homogeneous, and have increased in volume (~2 minutes). Each time you mix in a new ingredient, be sure to scrape down the sides of the bowl. One at a time, add your eggs and mix them in on low speed (don’t mix too aggressively!) Wait until the first egg is well incorporated before adding the second one. Add your milk, molasses, and vanilla extract to the bowl, and mix once more to combine.  5. Next, grab a spatula and fold in your date purée. Quickly whisk your baking powder & salt into your flour in a separate bowl. Once incorporated, start adding your flour, about 1/2 cup at a time, using a strainer to sift the flour into the bowl (this will remove any clumps). Ensure each 1/2 cup of flour is well incorporated before adding the next.  6. Grease 6 4.5oz ramekins with your remaining tbsp of softened butter, ensuring they are very well coated. You do not want your STPs to stick to the ramekins! Evenly divide the batter between the ramekins, ensuring you leave at least 1cm of space below the rim (because the puddings will rise quite a bit when baking). 7. Bake the ramekins for 20-30 minutes, or until a cake tester/toothpick comes out *slightly* moist when inserted in the middle of the pudding (not gooey with batter, but not dry either).  8. While the puddings are baking, make your sauce. Add your butter, cream, brown sugar and molasses to a pot, and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once at a boil, turn the heat down to low, and cook down your sauce until it has thickened & darkened in colour. You will know it’s done when the bubbles on the surface of the sauce are very small (because most of the moisture has already boiled away). Remove your sauce from the burner, but keep in a warm place.  RECIPE CONTINUES IN THE COMMENTS ⬇️ #stp #stickytoffeepudding #dessert #homecooking #recipe

Recipe Name Slow Roasted Glazed Beef Chuck Roast Ingredients 1. 3–4 lb beef chuck roast 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tsp kosher salt 4. 1 1/2 tsp black pepper 5. 2 tsp garlic powder 6. 1 tsp onion powder 7. 1 tsp smoked paprika 8. 1 tsp dried thyme 9. 1/2 tsp dried rosemary 10. 5 cloves garlic, minced 11. 1 medium yellow onion, sliced 12. 1 cup beef broth 13. 1/2 cup barbecue sauce 14. 1/4 cup honey 15. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 16. 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 17. 1 tbsp brown sugar 18. 2 tbsp butter Recipe 1. Remove the beef roast from the refrigerator and pat it dry. 2. Combine the salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, thyme, and rosemary. 3. Rub the seasoning generously over the entire roast. 4. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet or roasting pan over medium-high heat. 5. Sear the roast on all sides until deeply browned and caramelized. 6. Transfer the roast to a baking or roasting pan if needed. 7. Scatter the sliced onion and minced garlic around the beef. 8. Whisk together the beef broth, barbecue sauce, honey, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, and brown sugar. 9. Pour the sauce around the roast, keeping most of the glaze on the surface of the beef. 10. Dot the top with butter and cover the pan tightly with foil or a lid. 11. Place the roast in a preheated 325°F (165°C) oven. 12. Roast slowly until the beef becomes fork-tender and can be pulled apart easily. 13. Carefully remove the cover and spoon the pan juices over the roast. 14. Increase the oven temperature to 400°F (200°C) and return the uncovered roast to the oven. 15. Baste the roast several times with the thickened pan juices until the exterior becomes glossy, dark, and caramelized. 16. Remove the roast from the oven and let it rest for 15–20 minutes. 17. Slice the roast against the grain or pull it apart into tender pieces. 18. Spoon the caramelized glaze and pan juices over the sliced beef before serving. Creamy Tuscan White Beans Ingredients (4-5 servings): • 2 (15-oz) cans white beans, Great Northern or cannellini, drained and rinsed • 1½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved • ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped • 1 small yellow onion, finely diced • 4 garlic cloves, finely minced • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, plus more to taste • 1 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups broth • ½ cup whole milk • 1 tsp Dijon mustard • ½ cup finely grated Parmesan, plus more for serving • 2–3 cups chopped kale, tough stems removed • 1 tbsp lemon juice • 1 tsp honey • ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper • Salt, to taste • Extra-virgin olive oil, for finishing • Crusty sourdough, for serving Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the olive oil and diced onion with a pinch of salt. Cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly golden. 2. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they’re blistered and beginning to collapse. Reserve some of the blistered tomatoes for later. 3. Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 30-60 seconds until fragrant.  4. Stir in Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, red pepper flakes and black pepper. 5. Sprinkle flour over everything and stir for about 30 seconds. Slowly pour in the broth while stirring, followed by the milk and Dijon mustard. 6. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened. 7. Stir in the beans and simmer gently for 5–7 minutes.  8. Mash about ⅓ of the beans against the side of the skillet with the back of a spoon. 9. Stir in the chopped kale, cover, and cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring once or twice, until tender but still vibrant. 10. Lower the heat and stir in the Parmesan until melted and glossy. 11. Add lemon juice and honey. Taste and adjust salt, pepper and red pepper flakes. If the sauce is thicker than you want, stir in a splash of broth. 12. Top with the reserved blistered tomatoes, Parmesan, black pepper and a drizzle of olive oil. Enjoy! #beans #whitebeans #fallrecipes #easydinner #dinneridea

Crispy Garlic Butter Chicken Sandwich 🍗 Chicken breast has ruined enough sandwiches. We’re using juicy thighs, a crunchy tapioca dredge, Nashville hot oil, and garlic butter sauce. Fried Chicken: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * 1 cup flour * 1 cup rice flour * 1½ cups mini tapioca pearls, soaked and drained * ⅓ cup hot sauce * ¼ cup Worcestershire sauce * 2 tsp paprika * 2 tsp cayenne * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp salt * ½ tsp pepper * Frying oil Garlic Butter Sauce: * ½ cup salted butter * 5–7 garlic cloves, diced * ¾ cup heavy cream * ½ cup chopped parsley * Salt and pepper Nashville Hot Oil: * ¼ cup warm frying oil * 1 tbsp cayenne * 1 tsp paprika * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp brown sugar * Pinch of salt Directions: 1. Soak tapioca pearls until soft and drain well. 2. Marinate chicken in hot sauce and Worcestershire. 3. Combine flours, spices, and tapioca pearls. Dredge chicken thoroughly. 4. Fry at 350°F until crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. 5. Mix Nashville spices with warm frying oil and brush onto chicken. 6. Melt butter, gently cook garlic, add cream and simmer until slightly thickened. Season and finish with parsley. 7. Brush with garlic butter sauce, assemble, and enjoy! #ChickenSandwich #FriedChicken #GarlicButter
